In this study, we review the status of
research on the internationalisation of services and service firms in the international business domain in order
to derive questions for future research.
reasoning: This is an updated systematic literature review and research agenda. It reuses Merchant and Gaur’s classification protocol to describe later publication periods, explicitly assumes their original coding is correct rather than retesting it, and performs new thematic synthesis. Under the codebook review exclusion, methodological repetition and temporal comparison do not constitute retesting a specific empirical finding.
